title: ADR-0143 Provenance: name cloud ADR-0115 as the commercial half (dated amendment note; the cloud record now exists)
body:
Filing gate ②: a pointer owed by #26768 item 3, now that its cloud record has landed. Filed by `repo:cloud` seat 2. ⛔ Not a claim. **Tier H**: `docs/adr/**` is dispatched at CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER, and the PR is governed (maintainer merge).

## 维护者速读

框架 ADR-0143（出站连接器认证归开源层）在 Provenance 一节写着：商业那一半要由 cloud 仓库的一份记录来定，而且「在它存在之前，以维护者裁决为准」。这份记录现在已经合并了，就是 cloud ADR-0115（objectstack-ai/cloud#3354，2026-10-30 合并）。这张卡给 ADR-0143 追加一条带日期的修订说明，指向它。ADR 只追加、不改写。

## Facts

- `docs/adr/0143-outbound-connector-auth-is-open-tier.md:35-50`, Provenance: "the commercial half … is owed as a cloud-repository record … Until it exists, the maintainer's ruling quoted above is the commercial decision of record." The table at `:440` lists that record as owed (#26702 item 1, #26768 item 3).
- cloud `docs/adr/0115-outbound-connector-auth-open-tier-commercial-boundary.md` landed via objectstack-ai/cloud#3354 (merge `d4c97b39`, 2026-10-30). It carries a `## Provenance` pointer back to ADR-0143.

## Work

1. Append a dated amendment note to ADR-0143's Provenance section (Prime Directive 13: amend, don't rewrite). It says the commercial half is `cloud ADR-0115` and names the cloud commit. Update the `:440` row's status the same way.
2. Do not edit the body of the decision.

## Done when

ADR-0143 names cloud ADR-0115 as its commercial half, and #26768 item 3 is closed out.
